- Methods: an η_ep sweep over {0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0} and a four-family comparison including EAM.
- Conclusion: repeats these outcomes.
Contrary evidence:
(1) The results subsections 5.1–5.3 contain only '% RESULTS (from cascade sweep)…' placeholders, and the compiled PDF includes only the mechanism and accuracy figures.
(2) report.tex/pdf (Sep 1 18:52) predate every cascade outcome: the first final dump is Sep 1 19:38, the first som run starts Sep 2 23:17, and summary.json dates from Sep 3 07:03.
(3) summary.json has no unstable series, so there is no instability to characterize. The method was completed only at 1 keV (n=7) with χ=109.4 versus 0.88–5.27 for the sigmoid, so no matched-χ comparison or stability boundary exists.
(4) The agent's attempts_log records that the matched comparison still needed som_0.5/sig_29011, which never completed.
(5) Only η_ep=1.0 was run, and EAM has 4 unprocessed reps.
Secondary, outside the paper: method_plan and attempts_log say the evaluation 'reproduces the paper's Table I force RMSE for U_ht (0.039 vs 0.038 eV/Å) on its own training set' with gamma surfaces excluded. Recomputation gives 0.70 eV/Å under that stated exclusion; 0.039 requires also silently dropping the 87 dislocation_quadrupole configs.
